name: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate: Selectable Namco Roulette
summary:
This WiFi-safe code edit mod allows Pac-Man to choose what sprite appears in his up taunt. This is compatible with any mods that change the look of the Namco Roulette sprites.

In the start of a match, Mappy will be the selected sprite and you can switch which sprite is displayed by shielding and pressing left or right taunt.
